mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility has improved from -18.7 to -6.3 over three weeks, signaling normalized outdoor activity that spills over into broader retail-and-recreation footfall within two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rose 12.4 points from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: PARKS remains at or above -6.3 for two more weeks while RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained positive GROCERY_PHARM values indicate households continue essential-only provisioning and avoid discretionary retail, keeping RETAIL_REC below baseline for four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM is positive for all four weeks (1.7 to 3.0)
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM stays positive for four more weeks while RETAIL_REC future 28-day mean exceeds the last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT has fallen to -26.3, crossing below -25; weak transit signals reduced mobility capacity and policy caution, driving RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: TRANSIT remains below -25 for two consecutive weeks but RETAIL_REC future 28-day mean is higher than the last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES below -12 and RESIDENTIAL above 15 together indicate a work-from-home regime, reducing weekday commuter footfall and thus depressing RETAIL_REC over four weeks.

failure_condition: Both conditions hold for two weeks while RETAIL_REC future 28-day mean exceeds the last 28-day mean.

evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC t-1w is -14.9 and t-0w is -17.6
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC future 28-day mean is lower than the last 28-day mean despite PARKS > -6.3 and GROCERY_PHARM > 3.0.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS improvement from -18.7 to -6.3 reflects outdoor-favoring conditions; if PARKS crosses above -5, activity shifts further away from indoor retail, lowering RETAIL_REC over two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS t-0w is -6.3, near the -5.0 threshold
failure_condition: PARKS rises above -5.0 and RETAIL_REC future 28-day mean exceeds the last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT at -26.3 and WORKPLACES at -14.1 show the commuter network remains suppressed; if TRANSIT worsens while WORKPLACES is below -14, retail recreation declines within one week.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT t-0w is -26.3 and WORKPLACES t-0w is -14.1
